Names of two victims of Turkish bombing on Afrin, al-Shahba cantons

ANHA's agency obtained the name of the citizen who lost his life and the other who was injured in the Turkish attack on the village of Beiloniya in Afrin and al-Shahba cantons.

On Sunday , at 10:30 local time, a drone belonging to the Turkish occupation army targeted two citizens on the road to the village of Beiloniya, which led to the loss of the citizen Ali Abdel Rahman Muhammad and the injury of the citizen Muhammad Muhammad Sabri Khaled.

This afternoon, the Turkish occupation state also bombed the villages of Kaloutiya, Khirbet Shamsa, and Kundi Muzn, 3 times.

T/ Satt.
